Question: I have heard in qassasul ambiya of maulana khair muhammad hijazi (maulana makki) that it is not mentioned in quran or any authentic hadith of prophet muhammad (s.a.w.) reaching to arsh. Plz clarify with reference in the light of quran and hadith? Answer ID: 2260 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1928/1513=H) We did not see Qisasul Anbiya. However, it is authentically proved that Hazrat Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) toured to Arsh (The Throne) while he went on Meraj (Celestial Ascension). The details can be seen in Seeratul Mustafa, volume 1 and other books as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
